parameters:
無玄様が表舞台から去って以降、
敵は勢いを増したように思える。<EN>Ever since Mugen-sama departed from the public eye,
it seems the enemy's momentum has only increased.

私たちが弱すぎるがゆえの好機……か。
情けない、あまりにも……<EN>An opening born from our own weakness... is that it?
Truly, how pathetic...

無玄様はどこで何をされているのだろうか？
あの方は、国の現状を知っているのか……<EN>I wonder where she is and what she is doing?
Does she know the state this country is in right now...?
